sourceRefs.locator: Subsection Loma Caldera Eruption, cites McKee’s radiocarbon estimate at Cerén at 95% probability, AD 610–671. This dates a single eruption, not a decades-long volcanic episode.

Site setting and methodology, figs. 1–5 and discussion of Household 1. Wattle-and-daub buildings and thatch, dental plaster casts, manioc between Structures 6 and 11, field cultivation south of the village, fixed hearth and vessel contents in Structure 11.
Brief Synthesis and map coordinates, dossier 675, 13°49′39″ N, 89°22′9″ W. Seventh-century farming settlement preserved beneath the Loma Caldera eruption.
